findings_summary: External hostile read-only runtime-integration review of the two-commit repaired EMPTY_OBJECT result-algebra runtime stack ending at e62e6c3 (parent dfddf6b, base d025555). dfddf6b implements the three-result public materialization envelope in qntylab/r1_daily_market_materializer.py (materialize_parser_a): exact EMPTY_OBJECT observation-only handling, admission-bound schema identity via _validate_admitted_record, internal/private Parser-A candidate separation (INTERNAL_PARSER_A_CANDIDATE via _materialize_parser_a_unadmitted, not public evidence authority), fail-closed frozen result-algebra authority verification (_verify_result_algebra_authority) against the artifact recorded in r1_empty_object_result_algebra_amendment_review_v1, exact-X source identity preservation, and no change to Parser B. The first hostile review of dfddf6b returned R1_EMPTY_OBJECT_RESULT_ALGEBRA_RUNTIME_REPAIR_REQUIRED with exactly one blocker, PUBLIC_VALID_WITH_WRONG_SOURCE_OBJECT_HASH: materialize_parser_a's public boundary did not independently reverify candidate.record['source_object_sha256'] against sha256(exact raw_bytes) before promotion to MATERIALIZED_VALID_RECORD. e62e6c3 repairs this by adding three independent public-boundary equality checks (materializer lines ~608-622: candidate.raw_object_sha256 == raw_sha; candidate.record['source_object_sha256'] == raw_sha; evaluation.source_object_sha256 == raw_sha; each computed against raw_sha == sha256(exact raw_bytes)) plus three targeted public-boundary substitution tests in tests/test_r1_empty_object_result_algebra_runtime_v1.py. The final hostile rereview of exact repaired HEAD e62e6c3 reported PASS_SAFE_TO_RECORD_AND_PUSH_FROZEN_EMPTY_OBJECT_RUNTIME_IMPLEMENTATION with no blockers and no required changeset. No frozen protocol artifact was touched by either reviewed commit; git diff against parent d025555 over experiments/data/ is empty.

direct_materialization_result_constructi.boundary: No supported materialize_parser_a, materialize_parser_b, or materialize_batch input permits this forgery, and repository production code does not trust an ambient caller-created result as authoritative output.
direct_materialization_result_constructi.description: A caller can manually instantiate a MaterializationResult carrying MATERIALIZED_VALID_RECORD and an arbitrary record and obtain is_valid=true.
direct_materialization_result_constructi.future_hardening: Consider a private/factory-gated result constructor only if future code begins accepting ambient MaterializationResult instances as authority.
